items.title: What Does Thermo Fisher Scientific (TMO) Mean By A New $5 Billion Buyback?
items.summary: Thermo Fisher Scientific (NYSE:TMO) approved a new US$5b share repurchase program, replacing its prior authorization. The refreshed buyback plan gives the life sciences group additional capacity to retire stock through future share repurchases. The new authorization indicates Thermo Fisher Scientific intends to continue returning capital to shareholders through ongoing share repurchase activity. There is more to Thermo Fisher Scientific than the newly approved US$5b share repurchase program...
